rubric.checks: A fancy word stands in for a plain one.
rubric.fix: Use the plain word.

rubric.checks: Words that delay the point without adding to it.
rubric.fix: Delete the phrase.

rubric.checks: A costume for “is” or “has”.
rubric.fix: Say “is” or “has”.

rubric.checks: Praise instead of description.
rubric.fix: Describe the thing and let the reader judge.

rubric.checks: Announces a point instead of making it.
rubric.fix: Cut the opener and start with the point.

rubric.checks: Sets up a claim just to knock it down.
rubric.fix: State the second half on its own.

rubric.checks: Three items for rhythm, not because there are three.
rubric.fix: Keep the items that carry meaning.

rubric.checks: Several hedges in one claim dodge commitment.
rubric.fix: Keep one hedge, or commit.

rubric.checks: Cites authority nobody can check.
rubric.fix: Name the source, or cut the claim.

rubric.checks: Bolts an unsupported conclusion onto a fact.
rubric.fix: Cut the clause, or give it its own evidence.

rubric.checks: A conversational leftover that addresses no real reader.
rubric.fix: Delete it.

rubric.checks: “From X to Y” with no real scale between them.
rubric.fix: Name the things, or the one that matters.

rubric.checks: Asserts importance instead of showing it.
rubric.fix: Say what happened and let the reader judge.

rubric.checks: Could describe any company; no specific detail or stance.
rubric.fix: Add a specific fact, example or opinion.

rubric.checks: Says the same thing again without adding to it.
rubric.fix: Say it once, then move on.

rubric.checks: Explains what the reader already knows.
rubric.fix: Cut to what's new to the reader.

rubric.checks: Every sentence has the same length and shape.
rubric.fix: Vary the sentence lengths; combine or split some.

rubric.checks: A dramatic pause before a reveal.
rubric.fix: Use a period or a comma.

rubric.checks: A colon used as a hinge between claims, not to introduce a list.
rubric.fix: Split it into two sentences.

rubric.checks: Title Case headings read like marketing copy.
rubric.fix: Use sentence case.

rubric.checks: Bold used for emphasis instead of scanning.
rubric.fix: Keep bold for labels a reader scans for.
